verdict.rationale: Docs describe substantive bug-catching capability beyond style — TREX runtime sandbox that surfaces race conditions/logic bugs via traces and screenshots, static+AI security scanning, and v5's parallel agent swarm claiming fewer false positives and more real bugs caught. Community evidence partially corroborates real-world value (comm-8: 'catches real issues... gives author a chance to fix before human reviews') but also shows mixed accuracy experiences on complex code (comm-3: incomplete/incorrect answers on C++ templates) and reliability hiccups reported for the platform generally. Missing for 10: independent, PR-review-specific benchmarks or hands-on accounts confirming it reliably finds logic errors/race conditions (not just Q&A accuracy), and no rebuttal to the noted accuracy gaps.
